{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America expresses support for The Disability Integration Act (SB 2427).",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Disability Integration Act (SB 2427) would ensure seniors and people with disabilities have the financial resources necessary to receive in home and community-based services as an alternative to institutionalization.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Disability Integration Act (SB 2427) would stop states and insurance companies from denying seniors and people with disabilities the right to continue living in their communities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America believes the Disability Integration Act (SB 2427) is part of a larger fight to secure basic civil rights for seniors and people with disabilities.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America views ensuring all people have the capacity to lead flourishing lives and participate as equal members of society as part of the struggle for genuine equality.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America views the fight for a society that enables people with disabilities to live good lives with dignity as a central component of its democratic socialist vision.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
